text:
**Verdict**

Quality score: **4/10**. The code is readable and reasonably small, but I would not approve it as-is because the advertised tiny end-to-end path is broken from a clean workspace, generated outputs are masking missing inputs, and there are several reproducibility and validation gaps.

I installed the declared lightweight deps and ran `python -m pytest`: **6 passed, 1 failed**. The failure is the integration test: `extract --tiny` raises `FileNotFoundError` for `data/stories/manifest.json`.

**Concrete Issues**

| Severity | File | Lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| high | [emovec/extract.py](/work/emovec/extract.py:26) | 26-27 | Tiny extraction still requires external `data/stories` files, so the documented CPU demo fails in this repo. |
| high | [tests/test_integration_tiny.py](/work/tests/test_integration_tiny.py:12) | 12 | End-to-end test currently fails at extraction with missing `data/stories/manifest.json`. |
| high | [README.md](/work/README.md:54) | 54-65 | README advertises `make demo` / tiny commands that do not run from the checked-out project state. |
| medium | [outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json](/work/outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json:25) | 25-67 | Committed/stale generated artifacts reference a source story manifest that is absent from the repo. |
| medium | [emovec/config.py](/work/emovec/config.py:38) | 38-39 | Relative `stories_dir` is resolved against process CWD, not the config file location, making CLI runs fragile. |
| medium | [emovec/validate_contexts.py](/work/emovec/validate_contexts.py:21) | 21-24 | Validation loads vector metadata but does not enforce backend/model/dimension compatibility with the selected config. |
| medium | [emovec/steer_prefs.py](/work/emovec/steer_prefs.py:26) | 26-30 | Preference steering has the same missing artifact/config compatibility checks as context validation. |
| medium | [emovec/vector_ops.py](/work/emovec/vector_ops.py:16) | 16-32 | `pca_components_for_variance(..., threshold=0)` still returns one component instead of zero. |
| medium | [emovec/model.py](/work/emovec/model.py:149) | 149-152 | Tiny backend uses substring counts for emotion lexicon matches, which can create false activations. |
| low | [emovec/elo.py](/work/emovec/elo.py:22) | 22-29 | Elo ratings are order-dependent because pair iteration is fixed and repeated, which can bias reported rankings. |
| low | [pyproject.toml](/work/pyproject.toml:10) | 10-23 | Dependencies are broad lower bounds only, with no lockfile or upper bounds, weakening reproducibility. |

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **about 260 LOC**. Main work: make tiny mode self-contained or include the dataset, remove/regenerate stale outputs, add artifact/config validation, fix path resolution and PCA edge cases, and harden tests around clean-checkout behavior.

Bottom line: **No, I would not approve this PR as-is.**
